target.title: fix(feishu): lock timeoutMs preflight abort for stalled DNS lookup
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Feishu app registration goes through `fetchWithSsrFGuard`. Operators need a locked regression that a **stalled DNS/proxy preflight** is cancelled by the guards existing top-level `timeoutMs` before any HTTP request is dispatched.

## Why This Change Was Made

ClawSweeper P1 on the prior tip: replacing `timeoutMs` with `AbortSignal.timeout()` does **not** add preflight protection — `fetchWithSsrFGuard` already converts `timeoutMs` into the preflight abort signal via `buildTimeoutAbortSignal`, and swapping owners only drops the shared `request timed out` diagnostic.

**This iteration (rebased on latest main):**
- Rebuilt on latest `main` (`22563878857`)
- **Kept** guard `timeoutMs` (no production ownership change)
- Added stalled-lookup regression next to the existing hang-POST timeout proof, matching its outcome shape
- The registration API (`FeishuAppRegistrationFetchOptions`) is unchanged on current main — test typechecks and passes as-is
- Existing SSRF guard tests already cover stalled-DNS timeout at the guard level (`fetch-guard.ssrf.test.ts:1916,1939`); this Feishu test validates the full `beginAppRegistration` → `fetchWithSsrFGuard` call chain

## User Impact

- **Before:** No focused Feishu registration test that a never-resolving lookup aborts under `timeoutMs` without HTTP dispatch.
- **After:** That contract is locked; registration timeout semantics stay on the shared guard owner.

## Evidence

**Head SHA:** `6d7aab253ee`
**Base:** `22563878857`

### Before / After comparison

| Dimension | Before (no stalled-DNS test) | After (this PR adds regression) |
|---|---|---|
| DNS lookup stall coverage | ❌ Not tested | ✅ `stalledLookup` (never-resolving Promise) → aborted by `timeoutMs` |
| HTTP dispatch during preflight | ❌ Not verified | ✅ `fetchSpy not.toHaveBeenCalled()` — locked |
| Error type on stall | ❌ Not verified | ✅ Must be `TimeoutError` |
| Error message on stall | ❌ Not verified | ✅ Must be `"request timed out"` — shared diagnostic preserved |
| Stall timeout window | ❌ Not verified | ✅ `elapsedMs ≥ 60 && < 2000` — quick abort, no hang |
| Existing POST timeout test | ✅ Covers TCP-accept-no-headers path | ✅ Unchanged, same outcome shape |

### Matched outcome shape (new test vs existing POST sibling)

| Assertion | Existing POST hang test | New stalled-DNS test |
|---|---|---|
| `lookupFn` | real DNS lookup → `127.0.0.1` | `stalledLookup` (never resolves) |
| abort mechanism | `timeoutMs` → preflight AbortSignal | `timeoutMs` → preflight AbortSignal |
| outcome | `TimeoutError` / `request timed out` | `TimeoutError` / `request timed out` |
| `fetchImpl` | reaches TCP listener | ❌ **not called** (never reaches HTTP) |
| elapsed window | ≥60ms, <2000ms | ≥60ms, <2000ms |

### Full test suite (11/11 pass)

```

 ✓ Feishu app registration > parses under-cap JSON 19ms
 ✓ Feishu app registration > sends bound reads through real SSRF guard 7ms

 ✓ feishu bound reads > rejects oversized response (OOM guard) 82ms
 ✓ feishu bound reads > parses well-formed JSON under cap 14ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  11 passed (11)
   Start at  13:33:36
   Duration  2.72s

Host: LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
Date: 2026-07-17T13:33:39+08:00
```

### Targeted stall test proof

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-feishu.config.ts --reporter verbose extensions/feishu/src/app-registration.test.ts -t "rejects with timeout when preflight lookup stalls"

 RUN  v4.1.10

[feishu preflight stall proof] timed_out=true name=TimeoutError elapsed_ms=81 fetch_called=0

 ✓ 1 passed | 10 skipped (11)
   Duration  2.41s
```

**Output breakdown:**

| console.log field | Value | Assertion verified |
|---|---|---|
| `timed_out` | `true` | `expect(outcome.ok).toBe(false)` ✅ |
| `name` | `TimeoutError` | `expect(outcome.error.name).toBe("TimeoutError")` ✅ |
| `elapsed_ms` | `81` | `≥ 60 && < 2000` ✅ |
| `fetch_called` | `0` | `expect(fetchSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` ✅ |
